title: Network Participation Agreements: Claim Volume Relief on Repayment Plan Down Payments
content:
**Relief.** A practice under the **Network Participation Agreements** that is being paid a high volume of claims on an agreement has its repayment plan down payment on that agreement lowered. The down payment volume relief is set by the agreement's claim payments in remittances dated fewer than 3 whole months before today:

- 40000 USD or more subtracts 15 percentage points from the down payment percentage;
- 20000 USD or more but less than 40000 USD subtracts 8 percentage points;
- less than 20000 USD subtracts nothing.

The down payment percentage is the percentage at which the down payment base is taken.

## Terms

- **Claim payments in the window.** The total of the claim payment amounts on the agreement's remittances whose date is fewer than 3 whole months before today. Capitation and prompt-pay interest payments are not claim payments.
- **Whole months** are the difference in calendar months from the remittance date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the remittance date's day of the month.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical totals)

| Claim payments in the window | Percentage points subtracted |
|---|---|
| 19999.99 USD | Nothing |
| 20000.00 USD | 8 |
| 39999.99 USD | 8 |
| 40000.00 USD | 15 |
